text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, thank you for your hard work 
during training. I will now return to the 
dorms as schedul—
(THUD!)
Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Rear collision confirmed. Rice-san's 
head made contact with my back.
choice_data_list: Looks like... neither of us got hurt, huh.

Looks like... neither of us got hurt, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! I'm sorry for bumping into 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do... I thought night runs 
wouldn't cause trouble for anyone...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, it wasn't particularly a nuisance—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uh... I'm really, really sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Communication failed. Determined that 
my error generated erroneous data.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To Master: Proposing a change to the 
return schedule. ...Requesting permission 
to pursue her and correct the 
misunderstanding.
choice_data_list:
I'll pass along the message, so get some 
rest.
I'll pass it on for you, so get some rest

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Commencing Operation 
'Bug Elimination.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Rice-san, please wait.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-san! No, I'll cause trouble for 
her again! I-I have to get away, quick...!

And so the chase began, lasting until both 
of them ran out of stamina...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Thank you for looking out 
for my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please give this to Rice. It's an unopened 
sports drink.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I previously observed dryness on 
Rice-san's lips and sweat on her brow. I 
judge that prompt hydration is required.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san is one of my key rivals. It 
would be troublesome if she pushed herself 
too hard and collapsed."

Afterward, I chased Rice Shower on a 
bicycle as she went for a run, clearing up 
the misunderstanding along the way... and 
safely managed to hand over the 
refreshments.
